title: Players who trained with Lawrence and left: Halls, Arsenault, French brothers
summary: Lawrence names former band members and their instruments, including Clarence Hall, Herbert Trish, Roland Arsenault, Leroy, the French brothers, Fredo, Marzell and Lawrence Dewey.
